summary: Retest of the 4 frontend fixes from iteration_1 + core workspace regression check (frontend-only scope, backend suite not re-run). VERIFIED FIXED: (1) Responsive nav - mobile-nav-trigger visible at 768px and 390px, Sheet drawer opens with all 8 nav links + logout-btn, drawer navigation works (billing) and drawer closes on selection, logout from drawer returns to /login; desktop sidebar correctly hidden below lg. (2) Toast position - login toast renders bottom-right (y=1002 of 1080) with zero geometric overlap with credit-balance or studio-status-pill. (3) Markdown rendering in ai-plan-stream - ReactMarkdown+remarkGfm active (.gb-markdown), rendered <strong>=4, inline <code>=23, <table>=1, <ul>/<li> present, no literal '```' fences and no raw pipe tables. (4) Hard-stop UX - with credits forced to 3, backend hard_stop produced a persistent inline [data-testid=hard-stop-banner] ('Out of credits - This action needed 8 credits, you have 2. No further actions were queued.') plus buy-credits-cta which navigates to /billing. Regression: all 8 sidebar routes render at 1920px with no error nodes; prompt run streams a plan with 4 action cards (action-create_instance/action-write_script), Monaco code-preview populated with tabbed Luau (582 chars, monaco-editor mounted), credits 138->120 and ledger entries correct. HOWEVER a NEW CRITICAL backend regression was found and blocked the workspace flow initially (see backend_issues); I applied a 1-line undefined-variable fix in ai_agent.py to unblock retesting.

critical.issue: REGRESSION introduced by the atomic-credit-deduction fix: line 211/214 still referenced the removed local `credits` (renamed to start_credits), so Python resolved the builtin `credits` (_Printer) and EVERY prompt run aborted with SSE {type:error, message:'AI planner error: unsupported operand type(s) for -: _Printer and int'} -> 0 actions, no Luau, no credit spend. Reproduced via /app/backend/tests/sse_probe.py and in the UI (plan stopped after 'Step 1', 0 action cards). I fixed it in place (credits -> start_credits) and re-verified: 3 actions queued, 18 credits deducted, credits 156->138. Main agent should review the fix and add a regression test.

minor.issue: Still worth confirming - iteration_1 reported the redis supervisor program in FATAL state; not re-checked this round.

ui_bugs.issue: LOW: a few literal '**' pairs still appear in the completed plan text (bold markers emitted inside inline-code spans / table cells where markdown does not apply). Bold, code, lists and GFM tables otherwise render correctly.
Carry-over from iteration_1 (not fixed / not in scope this round): revoked keys accumulate with no filter or delete.

integration_issues.issue: Carry-over: estimate now says '~9+ credits (min)' which is honest labelling, but actual spend was 18 credits (2x the preview) for the demo Beacon prompt. Still misleading in magnitude.

issues: Bottom-right toast overlays the Luau Preview panel content on small screens (header is now safe, so this is cosmetic)

action_items: Review my 1-line fix in /app/backend/ai_agent.py (line 211/214: credits -> start_credits) and add a regression test asserting the SSE stream ends with a `done` event (no `error` event) for a normal prompt
Optionally align credit-estimate magnitude with real multi-script action pricing
Optionally strip stray '**' inside inline-code/table cells or instruct the model not to emit bold inside code spans
critical_code_review_comments: ai_agent.py: the pre-check `start_credits - spent < cost` is now redundant with the atomic conditional $inc below it; keeping both means the hard_stop `remaining` value can be stale. Consider relying solely on the atomic update (modified_count==0) path.
Plan text is never persisted in prompt_history (only prompt/actions/credits_used), so the History page cannot show what the model said - consider storing plan_text.
An undefined-name bug slipped through because `credits` is a Python builtin; enable a linter rule (flake8-builtins / ruff A001) on backend to catch builtin shadowing/misuse.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 iteration_1 frontend issues are fixed and verified (mobile Sheet drawer at 768/390, bottom-right toasts, markdown plan stream, persistent hard-stop banner + buy-credits CTA). Use /app/backend/tests/sse_probe.py for a fast raw-SSE check of the prompt endpoint before doing expensive UI runs - it prints all non-token events and the credit balance. Action cards use data-testid `action-<tool>` (e.g. action-write_script), NOT `action-card-*`. Mobile nav testids are duplicated in DOM (hidden desktop aside + drawer) so scope drawer assertions to [role="dialog"]. Each real prompt run costs ~18 credits.
rca_of_the_issue: The iteration_1 fix renamed the local `credits` snapshot to `start_credits` but left two references at ai_agent.py:211/214. Because `credits` is a CPython site builtin (_Printer), the name resolved silently instead of raising NameError, and the subtraction raised TypeError inside the SSE generator, which the except block converted into an `error` event - so the UI showed a truncated plan with 0 action cards and unchanged credits on every run. Fixed by using start_credits.
